name: Hyuga Shouta
source:
Code name: Age.
Self-centered, has fun of the moment if one presents itself, he
is also quite the playboy and enjoys hitting on women he also loves music.
Shouta is also skilled in questioning/interrogating subjects.
Ability: He can hypnotize people with his voice.

Shouta is an ordinary fourth-year university student and has a part time job at a convenience store, when he's not on a mission for Ark.
